<action type="say">
I tried searching for Italian spots in Austin based on what you remember, but nothing came back from the restaurant search, and I don’t have a tool that can look up a restaurant directly from its ID (RST-191). Because of that limitation, I can’t reliably give you the exact name and address from here.

Here are a few ways you can quickly find it on your side, given that we know the reservation is:
- Status: confirmed  
- Date: next Friday  
- Time: 19:15  
- Party size: 3  

Try these, in order:

1. Check your confirmation message  
   - Look in your email, SMS, or booking app for “RSV-6190” or the date/time “next Friday 7:15 PM.”  
   - The message that shows this confirmation code will usually list the restaurant name and address at the top.

2. Search your email or texts by keywords  
   - Search for “trattoria” and “Austin” together.  
   - Also search “reservation,” “7:15,” or the exact date of next Friday.

3. Check any reservation app or platform you used  
   - Open OpenTable, Resy, Yelp, Google Maps bookings, or the place you usually reserve through.  
   - Look at upcoming reservations for next Friday; tapping the reservation should show the full restaurant details and address.

4. If you used Google or Apple Maps  
   - In Google Maps or Apple Maps, check your “Recents” or “Timeline/History” for places viewed or searched around the time you booked.  
   - Look for Italian places with “Trattoria” in the name in Austin—those entries will have the full address.

5. As a last resort, check card or payment history  
   - If you’ve eaten there before, your bank/credit card statement might show the exact merchant name.  
   - You can then look that up in Maps to get the address.

If you can find the restaurant name from any of those, tell me what it is and I can double-check its details (address, hours, etc.) for you.  
Also, if you want to adjust or cancel the reservation itself (with code RSV-6190), I can help with that too.</action>
